remarks: Discover this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home nestled in the picturesque seaside town of Rowayton, CT. Boasting 2,000 square feet of bright and open living space, this fully furnished rental offers the perfect blend of modern elegance and coastal charm. Step inside to find sun-drenched rooms, stylish finishes, and a cozy fireplace, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The main floor features a luxurious master suite with a spa-like en suite bath and direct access to a private patio-your personal retreat for morning coffee or evening relaxation.  The open-concept kitchen, living, and dining areas are ideal for entertaining, while the private yard provides a serene space for outdoor gatherings or quiet moments in nature. With ample parking and a prime location, this home truly has it all.  Enjoy the convenience of in-town living, with Rowayton's charming shops, restaurants, and waterfront just a short stroll away. Plus, the home's proximity to top-rated schools and transportation options ensures easy commuting and access to all the area has to offer.  This fully furnished rental offers a turn-key opportunity to experience the quintessential Rowayton lifestyle. Don't miss your chance to call this stunning property home!
